title: Cerulean Cave & Elite Four Round 2
subtitle: Mewtwo, the stronger Elite Four, Champion rematch

steps.text: Cerulean Cave opens after the Ruby and Sapphire are delivered to Celio. Surf northwest of Cerulean City. Wild Pokémon are Lv.46-70: Golbat, Parasect, Ditto, Kadabra, Wobbuffet, Magneton, Electrode, Chansey, Lickitung; rods give Kingler and Seadra.
1F: weave through the rock maze to the ladders; items scattered on the ledges.
B1F: Mewtwo Lv.70 (Psychic, Recover, Swift, Safeguard). Save. Use the Master Ball, or paralyze it and throw Ultra Balls after lowering its HP with Bug/Ghost/Dark moves.
Once the Sevii quest is done the Elite Four use much stronger teams (Lv.63-75) with Johto/Hoenn Pokémon. Aim for Lv.70+.
Lorelei round 2: Dewgong Lv.64, Cloyster Lv.63, Piloswine Lv.63, Jynx Lv.66, Lapras Lv.66.
Bruno round 2: Steelix Lv.65 ×2 (Fire/Water/Ground/Fighting), Hitmonchan Lv.65, Hitmonlee Lv.65, Machamp Lv.68.
Agatha round 2: Gengar Lv.66 and Lv.70, Crobat Lv.66, Misdreavus Lv.65, Arbok Lv.68.
Lance round 2: Gyarados Lv.68, Dragonite Lv.66 and Lv.72, Kingdra Lv.66 (only Dragon hurts it much), Aerodactyl Lv.70.
Champion rematch: Heracross Lv.72, Alakazam Lv.73, Tyranitar Lv.72, two of Arcanine/Gyarados/Exeggutor Lv.73, starter Lv.75.
